Must-Fix `2654-meth-1`: plan v1 §3.1(d) fetched the two window-endpoint file
texts unconditionally with a new `strip=False` keyword, while §2 claimed the
reads "run only when the chase ended conclusively". Two pre-existing tests
monkeypatch the module `_git` with a fake whose signature is exactly
`(args, *, cwd)` — `tests/test_check_cited_body_currency.py` lines 786-793 and
870-877, the latter one of the two round-5 tests acceptance criterion 3 names —
and both reach the tail of `body_diff_since`, so the new keyword would raise
`TypeError` and ERROR both tests. Beyond violating acceptance criterion 3, that
would have fired the plan's own §6 kill criterion ("a pre-existing test that is
itself correct breaks") on a defect outside the design, steering the
implementer to the allowlist fallback §2 correctly rejects.

**Independently re-verified before acceptance** rather than taken at face
value: both fake signatures read directly from `origin/issue-2384`, and
`grep -n 'setattr(ccb, "_git"'` returns exactly lines 793 and 877 — both
inconclusive-window fixtures. The two `_boom` fakes (lines 201, 965) take
`(*_a, **_k)` and are signature-safe either way.

v2 fixes it with a `need_text = conclusive and bool(diff) and not
is_rename_only_window(window)` gate, extracts `is_rename_only_window` so the
gate and the `rename-only` branch share one predicate, adds a test pinning zero

failure exactly when it succeeds), and the frontmatter opener widened from an
